prompt:
Pixel-art first-person view for a Doom/Hexen-style dungeon game: the player's own two armoured hands CASTING A SPELL, seen from the player's eyes, from behind, as in Hexen or Heretic, where the hands sit at the bottom of the screen. One single frame, not a sprite sheet.

REFERENCE IMAGE 1 is the game's existing first-person SWORD frame: a right gauntlet (steel plates, brass rivets, a leather-and-brass cuff, a steel vambrace running off the bottom of the screen). It sets the style: the pixel size, the dark outline weight, the shading, the colours, and the scale of the hand. REFERENCE IMAGE 2 is the same player holding a spear in both hands: the left gauntlet is the right one's mirror twin. Draw exactly these gauntlets, cuffs and vambraces, at the same size as in reference 2. Do not draw the sword or the spear: the hands are empty but for the magic.

THE MAGIC: there is NO FIRE in this picture at all: no flames, no embers, nothing orange or yellow but the gauntlets' small brass rivets and what THIS POSE describes. The magic is described under THIS POSE and is drawn as crisp pixel art with hard edges, a few flat tones, no smooth glow, no soft halo, and no light cast on the background. It never covers the upper half of the screen's middle unless the pose says so.

THE PICTURE
- The whole 1536 x 1024 canvas is the player's screen.
- The camera is the player's eyes: the hands are the nearest things, much bigger than they would be in a third-person view. No body, no shoulders, no head, no legs.
- Both forearms run off the BOTTOM edge of the screen, the left one left of the screen's middle and the right one right of it, never off the side edges.
- The upper half of the screen and its centre stay empty unless the pose says otherwise: it is where the player looks.

STRICT RULES
- Background: flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere around the hands and the magic: no floor, no walls, no gradient, no vignette, no glow, no shadow.
- Crisp pixel art with hard edges and no anti-aliasing against the magenta. No semi-transparent pixels and no pink or purple glow bleeding into the background.
- No text, labels, frame borders, grid lines, motion blur, and no effects other than the magic described.

THIS POSE:
HEALING, at rest. The rest pose of REFERENCE IMAGE 3 exactly, but with no fire: instead, a long narrow ribbon of soft pale green-white light winds loosely round each vambrace and wrist, two lazy turns each, like a glowing bandage come loose, its free end trailing up past the fingertips and curling.

REFERENCE IMAGE 3 is these hands' rest pose, already drawn: keep exactly its two gauntlets, cuffs and vambraces, at the same scale and in the same style. Only the pose changes, and the fire in its palms is not drawn: the magic described above takes its place.
